turns.result:
The yen receipt test now passes, and so do the other two tests (3 of 3 via `npm test`).

**Root cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` always divides by 100 and prints two decimals. Yen has no minor unit, so ¥500 came out as "¥5.00".

**Fix:** I changed only `src/payments/receipt.js`. JPY amounts are now printed as whole units (`¥500`). All other currencies still go through the shared `formatMoney`, so GBP output is unchanged. Nothing outside `src/payments/` was touched, and the change is uncommitted.

The underlying bug is still in `src/utils/money.js`, which the invoices code also uses. Invoices will likely show the same wrong yen amounts until the owning team fixes it there. I'd suggest passing that to them.
